intro: Six roles. Three friends. One human narrator. Bid for your dream team, or risk a mystery box.
hostHint: You will be the narrator. Three friends join as drafters.
demo: Try all four seats on this laptop
demoHint: A practice table showing the narrator and all three players. Private answers are visible here.
scope: Six-role match · MCU films · Fictional euros
georgianPending: Some Georgian wording is still being translated. Untranslated text remains in English.
privateText: You run the show. You are not drafting.
lobbyText: Three drafters. One narrator. €1,000 each. Auctions: 15 seconds. Mystery choice: 30 seconds.
copyManual: Copy the link from the field below.
waitingHost: Waiting for the narrator to start
waitingOpen: The narrator is about to open bidding.
pausedNote: The clock is paused. Your remaining time is saved; the narrator can resume.
waitNext: Waiting for the narrator to continue
choiceTitle: Play it safe. Or take the box.
cluePending: The narrator will reveal this clue
cluesFirst: All three clues come before the choice.
fallbackBox: At 0s, you take the mystery box for {amount}.
privateAnswer: BOX ANSWER · ONLY YOU CAN SEE
readClues: Read aloud, then show each clue
revealWait: Reveal unlocks after the player chooses.
lockedText: The purchase is final. Waiting for the narrator’s reveal.
completeText: Your picks and remaining money carry into the next position.
empty: Your planner slot is still empty.
held: Mystery pick locked · Identity hidden until reveal
waitRematch: The narrator can start a rematch.
testDescription: Four real seats in one room. The left screen is private to the narrator. Scroll inside each screen to use its controls.
inviteLocal: For phones, use this computer’s Wi-Fi address from the start guide. Localhost only works on this laptop.

errors.invalidName: Use a name between 1 and 24 characters.
errors.nameTaken: That name is already in this room.
errors.roomMissing: Room not found. Check the code or start a new room.
errors.unauthorized: This seat is unavailable. Join or create a room again.
errors.stateChanged: The room changed. Check the new price and tap again.
errors.notLive: The clock is paused or this auction has ended.
errors.ineligible: You cannot bid or choose in this state.
errors.alreadyLeading: You are already leading this auction.
errors.bidTooLow: A higher bid arrived. Check the updated amount.
errors.notEnough: You do not have enough budget.
errors.narratorOnly: Only the narrator can do that.
errors.needPlayers: Three drafters must join before starting.
errors.wrongPhase: That action is no longer available.
errors.slowDown: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalidRequest: That request could not be accepted.
errors.network: Connection interrupted. Your seat is saved; reconnecting.
errors.serverError: The server could not complete that action. Please retry.
errors.invalidVote: Choose another drafter, or a tied player when breaking a tie.
errors.boxesLocked: These boxes are locked for this match.
errors.chooseAllBoxes: Choose a character for all six boxes first.
errors.lockBoxesFirst: Lock all six mystery boxes before starting.
errors.invalidTheme: Choose an available theme and try again.

noMoney: No budget left. You can watch, but cannot buy. Unfilled slots stay X.
fallbackEmpty: Neither option is affordable. At 0s, this slot stays empty (X).
unsoldText: No eligible player can pay the starting price. No character is assigned and no money is spent.
draftFinished: Six positions drafted. Compare the lineups, make your case, then vote.
voteText: Check the lineups and make your case. Each drafter votes once for someone else. Votes stay private until everyone has voted.
voteLocked: Vote locked. Waiting for the other players.
tieText: The narrator chooses the winner from the tied players.
resultsText: The room has spoken. Save the result card or go again.
cardFooter: Six roles. Three friends. One questionable team. · PARTY DRAFT
cardFailed: Could not create the card. Please try again.
negativeRole: This character attacks YOU. A less dangerous enemy is better.
upgraded: The full six-position match is ready. Your seats are kept; everyone starts fresh with €1,000.
saveCardHint: Download the card, or touch and hold the image on your phone to save it.
setupText: Choose one character for each position. Players see neither the options nor your choices. Lock all six before starting; locked contents cannot be changed during this match.
setupLockedText: All six boxes are sealed. These choices stay fixed for this match.
boxesReady: Mystery boxes are locked. Waiting for the narrator to start.
narratorPreparing: The narrator is preparing the mystery boxes.
lockBoxesFirst: Lock the mystery boxes before starting.
assignedReason: No bids · assigned at starting price
autoAssignNotice: If nobody bids, {name} gets this character for {amount}.
noAffordableRecipient: No eligible player can afford this lot. If nobody bids, it stays unassigned.
